troubleshooting.title: A page says no person is selected
troubleshooting.shortdesc: What to do when Person, Family tree or Events have nobody to show.

condition.p: You choose , , or . No person is open. The chip at the top starts with , and it reads Showing: the focal person instead of a name.

cause.p: These pages show one person at a time. You have not opened anyone yet.

step.cmd: Type a name in the search box, then choose . Or choose .
Choose the card of the person you want.

stepresult.p: The chip that starts with shows their name. The page now works.

cause.p: The tree has nobody in it yet. On the line under its name says 0 persons · 0 families · 0 events, and the chip says Showing: the focal person.

stepresult.p: shows how to add the person.
